# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 13 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 13:4 — happened to me vs. experienced

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "that happened to me in paradise" | Literal quae acciderunt mihi |
| LOGOS | "that I have seen and experienced in paradise" | Combines videre and accidere |
| PNEUMA | "all that I have seen and experienced" | Same as LOGOS |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS/PNEUMA agree: 'seen and experienced.' The Latin has both 'seen' and 'happened to' — LOGOS combines them naturally. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.
